summary: Adds the first functional Pi extension UI bridge: server-side PiExtensionUiRuntime tests and protocol validation for extension.ui.* events, an app-side FakeAgentClient.resolveExtensionUi helper, integration tests rendering and resolving semantic extension UI, plus MessageList/Titlebar streaming activity wired to extensionUi.workingFor and a session.reload sequence that clears and starts a new runtime.
decisions: PiExtensionUiStore is now optional (extensionUi?) in MessageList and uses optional chaining when computing streaming activity, allowing consumers like Titlebar to omit it.
Session reload wraps the existing beforeSessionStart hook to both extensionUi.clear() and extensionUi.startNewRuntime(), ensuring prior UI requests are dropped before the new runtime begins.
PiExtensionWidgets.svelte renders widget lines via widget.request.lines?.join('\n') rather than an {#each} block to satisfy Svelte 5's keyed-each lint without adding a key.
A new CSS rule for [data-ui='streaming-custom-indicator'] is defined alongside the existing streaming-cursor styles to render working-state text via a mono accent-colored element.
docs/pi-extension-ui-bridge-plan.md is updated to mark the first functional bridge milestone as implemented, and docs/extensions.md notes the active bridge milestones.
errors: Svelte 5 autofixer flagged an unkeyed {#each} over widget.request.lines in PiExtensionWidgets.svelte; resolved by joining lines into a single string.

Svelte 5 autofixer repeatedly surfaced a generic suggestion about reassigning stateful variables inside $effect across several Svelte components; resolved as informational with no source changes required.
